From: Manu K. <address removed>
Sent: Wednesday 9:12 AM
To: bookings@sekeron.example
Subject: need reel editor by friday

Hi,

Bit of a last minute one. We had a food pop-up over the weekend and shot everything on phones. Need one good vertical reel from it, around 30 sec.

There are about 70 clips in the folder (a lot are probably useless). Mostly prep in the kitchen, close shots of dishes, people coming in, and 3-4 customer reactions. We need the editor to go through it and find the story, not just put every clip in order.

Would like it energetic but still clean. Not crazy transitions. Captions where anyone is speaking. First cut by Friday evening if possible.

Budget 8-10k.

We have a logo and the song that was playing at the event. I don’t know if we can legally use that song on Instagram so the editor may need to suggest something else.

Thanks
Manu

----- reply, 9:36 AM -----

Hi Manu — do you need more than one aspect ratio or a shorter cut as well?

----- reply, 10:02 AM -----

Only 9:16 for now. If the main reel works we might ask for a 15 sec cut later, but please don’t include that in this quote yet.

Phone enquiry notes / 19 Aug
Ref H-117

Shalini from the people team called about a photographer for their leadership off-site on 4 Sept. Venue is not final, somewhere in South Delhi.

Her first ask was: “please not the usual stiff conference photos”. She wants people talking, doing the exercises, reactions during the two sessions, lunch etc. Also one proper full-team photograph before people start leaving.

Around 120 people (she said could be 110, could be 130).
Likely 10am–3pm.

She then asked whether the photographer could squeeze in quick headshots for the leadership team. Maybe 10–15 people. I told her this might need a separate setup/time, and she said candid event coverage is more important if both are not realistic.

Needs 8–10 pictures the same evening for LinkedIn. Rest can come later that week.

No fixed budget shared. Her words were “send me two sensible options, procurement will ask anyway”. We don’t know the room or whether flash is allowed yet.
